body.statement: The minimum-weight hitting-set problem reduces in polynomial time to the ordinary minimum-cost intervention problem.  In the cited construction, original vertices retain their hitting-set weights, auxiliary vertices have prohibitive infinite cost, and finite-cost identifying interventions are exactly the hitting sets with the same cost.

source.locator: Theorem 3, printed page 8, and its proof on printed pages 32--34

attestation.note: Checked directly against Theorem 3 on printed page 8 and its cost-preservation Claims 1--3 on printed pages 32--34 in the official JMLR PDF on 2026-09-11.
